dialogues.jp: 「杉並、おはよっす」
dialogues.en: "Mornin', Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Mornin', Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.jp: いつものように挨拶を交す。
dialogues.en: As always, morning greetings.
dialogues.text: As always, morning greetings.

dialogues.jp: いつものような、親友同士の軽い朝の挨拶。
dialogues.en: As always, light chatter with friends in the morning.
dialogues.text: As always, light chatter with friends in the morning.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、杉並」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Suginami."

dialogues.jp:
続いて教室に入ってきた叶も、いつものように
軽く杉並に声をかける。
dialogues.en:
Following close behind, Kanae greeted Suginami as usual as
well.
dialogues.text:
Following close behind, Kanae greeted Suginami as usual as
well.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.jp:
叶は俺の顔をちらりと見あげ、そのまま自分の
席についた。
dialogues.en: Kanae glanced at me for a second, then went to her desk.
dialogues.text: Kanae glanced at me for a second, then went to her desk.

dialogues.jp:
俺もあえて声をかけることはせず、ただそれを
見送る。
dialogues.en: As soon as I heard her voice, I did the same as well.
dialogues.text: As soon as I heard her voice, I did the same as well.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前たち、何かあったのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's up with you two?"
dialogues.text: "What's up with you two?"

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達を見て、杉並は｛いぶか／訝｝しげな表情で｛たず／訊｝ね
てきた。
dialogues.en: Looking at us suspiciously, he raised his doubt.
dialogues.text: Looking at us suspiciously, he raised his doubt.

dialogues.jp: 「何かって？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Eh...... you know."
dialogues.text: "Eh...... you know."

dialogues.jp: 杉並にしては妙に歯切れの悪い調子で切り出す。
dialogues.en: He gritted his teeth, as I refused to answer directly.
dialogues.text: He gritted his teeth, as I refused to answer directly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「王子様と喧嘩でもしてるのか？　最近妙に素っ
　気無いじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"Did you quarrel with your prince? Both of you have been
acting strange recently."
dialogues.text:
"Did you quarrel with your prince? Both of you have been
acting strange recently."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「別にこんなもんだろ。だいたい、もともと何
　もなかったのをお前らが妙に誤解してただけ
　なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Not particularly. It's you people who misunderstood things
that're the weird ones."
dialogues.text:
"Not particularly. It's you people who misunderstood things
that're the weird ones."

dialogues.jp: 俺はこともなげに答えた。
dialogues.en: I answered without a care in the world.
dialogues.text: I answered without a care in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Humph..."
dialogues.text: "Humph..."

dialogues.jp: 微妙に複雑そうな杉並を無視して席につく。
dialogues.en:
Deciding not to press any further, Suginami returned to his
seat.
dialogues.text:
Deciding not to press any further, Suginami returned to his
seat.

dialogues.jp:
誰も俺や叶に冷やかしの声をかけてくる者はい
ない。
dialogues.en: No one else tried to talk to either of us.
dialogues.text: No one else tried to talk to either of us.

dialogues.jp: 人の噂も七十五日……。
dialogues.en: These people can gossip for like 75 days straight...
dialogues.text: These people can gossip for like 75 days straight...

dialogues.jp:
実際にはそんなに時間がたっているわけではな
いのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Of course, it didn't take that long for the gossip revolving
around us to die down...
dialogues.text:
Of course, it didn't take that long for the gossip revolving
around us to die down...

dialogues.jp:
移り気なクラスの連中は、早くも違う噂に飛び
ついて俺達のことを忘れ始めているようだ。
dialogues.en:
These fickle gossipers, as soon as they heard a different
and more scandalous rumour, the original one was forgotten.
dialogues.text:
These fickle gossipers, as soon as they heard a different
and more scandalous rumour, the original one was forgotten.

dialogues.jp: あれから、俺と叶は電話で長く話し合った。
dialogues.en:
Kanae and I talked on the phone about this, for a very long
time.
dialogues.text:
Kanae and I talked on the phone about this, for a very long
time.

dialogues.jp:
俺が出した結論、それは、恋人としての語らい
を慎むこと……。
dialogues.en:
The conclusion I came up with, was that we had to be more
careful about how we acted in public.
dialogues.text:
The conclusion I came up with, was that we had to be more
careful about how we acted in public.

dialogues.jp:
叶の秘密を……そして俺達の関係を守るために
は、そうするしかないと思った。
dialogues.en:
In order to protect our connection, and her secret... that's
the only thing we could do, I thought.
dialogues.text:
In order to protect our connection, and her secret... that's
the only thing we could do, I thought.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は以前のように――いや、はたから見れば
さらに冷淡な「ただ単に同じクラスにいるだけ
の存在」となっていた。
dialogues.en:
So we had to go back to being indifferent, just being
"people who happen to be in the same class".
dialogues.text:
So we had to go back to being indifferent, just being
"people who happen to be in the same class".

dialogues.jp: 必要最低限しか言葉を交さないクラスメイト。
dialogues.en: Simply classmates, with the barest minimum of communication.
dialogues.text: Simply classmates, with the barest minimum of communication.

dialogues.jp:
そんなのは噂好きな奴らにとって何の興味も呼
び起こさない。
dialogues.en:
The busybodies soon lost interest at the lack of anything
happening between us.
dialogues.text:
The busybodies soon lost interest at the lack of anything
happening between us.

dialogues.jp:
今の奴らのターゲットは俺と叶ではなく……。
叶と――。
dialogues.en:
Now, their target isn't Kanae and myself anymore... It's
Kanae and--
dialogues.text:
Now, their target isn't Kanae and myself anymore... It's
Kanae and--

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ことり、一緒に食堂行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "...Kotori, let's go to the cafeteria."
dialogues.text: "...Kotori, let's go to the cafeteria."

dialogues.jp:
４時限目が終わると、工藤はまっすぐことりの
席へ向かった。俺に一度も目を向けることなく。
dialogues.en:
As soon as 4th period ended, Kudou went straight for
Kotori's desk. I didn't even look in their direction.
dialogues.text:
As soon as 4th period ended, Kudou went straight for
Kotori's desk. I didn't even look in their direction.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Ah... okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah... okay."

dialogues.jp:
ちら、と俺の方を見ながら叶と共に教室を出る
ことり。
dialogues.en:
Kotori gave me a worried glance before leaving the classroom
with Kanae.
dialogues.text:
Kotori gave me a worried glance before leaving the classroom
with Kanae.

dialogues.jp:
そんな二人を眺めながら好き勝手な会話が交さ
れる。
dialogues.en:
The nosey gossipers, seeing the two of them leaev together,
immediately started their trash.
dialogues.text:
The nosey gossipers, seeing the two of them leaev together,
immediately started their trash.

dialogues.speaker: Guy B
dialogues.jp: 「工藤と白河は決定かな」
dialogues.en: "Looks like Kudou's chosen Shirakawa."
dialogues.text: "Looks like Kudou's chosen Shirakawa."

dialogues.speaker: Guy C
dialogues.jp:
「っぽいよな、あの様子じゃ。あ〜あ、工藤相
　手じゃ太刀打ちできないぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Sure what it looks like. Haaah, no way I could match up to
him for Shirakawa's heart."
dialogues.text:
"Sure what it looks like. Haaah, no way I could match up to
him for Shirakawa's heart."

dialogues.jp:
俺達の疑惑に代わって再浮上してきたのは叶と
ことりの噂だった。
dialogues.en:
The main thing that kept the relationship between Kanae and
I from surfacing, was the new one between Kanae and Kotori.
dialogues.text:
The main thing that kept the relationship between Kanae and
I from surfacing, was the new one between Kanae and Kotori.

dialogues.jp: ことりは……叶のことを知っているんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Kotori... does she... know about Kanae?
dialogues.text: Kotori... does she... know about Kanae?

dialogues.jp: （……多分、全部分かっているんだろうな）
dialogues.en: "(...She probably knows everything.)"
dialogues.text: "(...She probably knows everything.)"

dialogues.jp: おそらく、俺よりもずっと以前から。
dialogues.en: Perhaps even before I did.
dialogues.text: Perhaps even before I did.

dialogues.jp:
自分に正直に、と忠告したことりの言葉を思い
出す。
dialogues.en:
She was the one who told me to be honest with myself back
then.
dialogues.text:
She was the one who told me to be honest with myself back
then.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは叶の事情を知っているからこそ、とも
すれば不名誉に発展しかねない噂を敢えて流れ
るがままにさせておいたのだろう。
dialogues.en:
If she knows about Kanae, then she probably figured out what
we're trying to do, and appears to be playing the part well.
dialogues.text:
If she knows about Kanae, then she probably figured out what
we're trying to do, and appears to be playing the part well.

dialogues.jp: （ことりは立派だよな、それに引き換え……）
dialogues.en:
"(She's really something, that Kotori. I, on the other
hand...)"
dialogues.text:
"(She's really something, that Kotori. I, on the other
hand...)"

dialogues.jp: この俺はどうだ？
dialogues.en: What about me...?
dialogues.text: What about me...?

dialogues.jp:
まだあれから一週間も経たないっていうのに
……。
dialogues.en: Not even a week had passed since we decided on that...
dialogues.text: Not even a week had passed since we decided on that...

dialogues.jp: こんなにも苦しい。
dialogues.en: But already it's incredibly painful.
dialogues.text: But already it's incredibly painful.

dialogues.jp:
でも、俺はこのまま卒業までの長い時間を叶と
すれ違いながら過ごさなくてはならない。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't be able to stand keeping this distance all the
way till graduation.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't be able to stand keeping this distance all the
way till graduation.

dialogues.jp: 果たしてそんなことに耐えられるだろうか。
dialogues.en: I can't be expected to bear with it till then.
dialogues.text: I can't be expected to bear with it till then.

dialogues.jp: 本当はいつだってあいつの側にいてやりたい。
dialogues.en: All I really want, is to be by her side.
dialogues.text: All I really want, is to be by her side.

dialogues.jp: いつだって笑顔でいれるよう守ってやりたい。
dialogues.en: To be able to protect her smile always...
dialogues.text: To be able to protect her smile always...

dialogues.jp: 「いや、いてやりたいんじゃないんだ……」
dialogues.en: "...No, that's not what I really want..."
dialogues.text: "...No, that's not what I really want..."

dialogues.jp:
側にいてやりたいとか、幸せにしてやりたいと
か、そんなのはただの傲慢だ。
dialogues.en:
Saying that I want to be by her side, that's just my pride
speaking.
dialogues.text:
Saying that I want to be by her side, that's just my pride
speaking.

dialogues.jp: ほんとうは、
dialogues.en: The real truth is,
dialogues.text: The real truth is,

dialogues.jp: 俺が側にいて欲しいだけなんだよ。
dialogues.en: I want her to be by my side.
dialogues.text: I want her to be by my side.

dialogues.jp:
鳴り響く電話のベルに、俺はベッドからがばと
身を起こした。
dialogues.en: The ringing tone of the phone got me off the bed quickly.
dialogues.text: The ringing tone of the phone got me off the bed quickly.

dialogues.jp: 時計を見れば、ジャスト０時。
dialogues.en: I looked at the clock; exactly 12 midnight.
dialogues.text: I looked at the clock; exactly 12 midnight.

dialogues.jp: いつもの約束の時間だ。
dialogues.en: The promised time.
dialogues.text: The promised time.

dialogues.jp: 大急ぎでドアを開け、電話口に走る。
dialogues.en: I crashed open the door, and ran to the telephone.
dialogues.text: I crashed open the door, and ran to the telephone.

dialogues.jp: 「もしもし叶？」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Kanae?"
dialogues.text: "Hello, Kanae?"

dialogues.jp:
必死で息切れを抑える俺の耳に、くすくすと笑
い声が響いた。
dialogues.en:
As I tried to calm myself, short of breath, a familiar
giggle rang into my ear.
dialogues.text:
As I tried to calm myself, short of breath, a familiar
giggle rang into my ear.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『朝倉君ってば、私じゃなかったらどうする気
　なの？』
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun, if that wasn't me, you'd have been in
trouble."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun, if that wasn't me, you'd have been in
trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ……そんなこと考えてもみなかった」
dialogues.en: "Ah... I didn't think about that."
dialogues.text: "Ah... I didn't think about that."

dialogues.jp:
自分の慌てぶりが恥ずかしいやらなんやらで、
頭をかく。
dialogues.en:
I slapped my forehead. That hastiness could've led to a lot
of embarassment...
dialogues.text:
I slapped my forehead. That hastiness could've led to a lot
of embarassment...

dialogues.jp: 毎晩、真夜中０時にかかって来る叶からの電話。
dialogues.en: Every night, Kanae would call at 12 midnight on the dot.
dialogues.text: Every night, Kanae would call at 12 midnight on the dot.

dialogues.jp:
本当は俺からも電話したい所なんだけど、叶の
家の事情を考えるとなかなかそれもかなわない。
dialogues.en:
I would've wanted to be able to call her instead, but she
already has her own problems with her family and me.
dialogues.text:
I would've wanted to be able to call her instead, but she
already has her own problems with her family and me.

dialogues.jp: 怪しまれるとまずいしな……。
dialogues.en: Can't make it even more suspicious...
dialogues.text: Can't make it even more suspicious...

dialogues.jp:
「いつもお布団を被って電話してるんだよ」、
そう話す叶の、その姿を想像して笑ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I could see in my imagination, her grandma asking why she's
always hiding under her covers while on the phone...
dialogues.text:
I could see in my imagination, her grandma asking why she's
always hiding under her covers while on the phone...

dialogues.jp:
「お前、今日体育の後具合悪そうだったけど
　……大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "You seemed in a bad state after gym class... are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "You seemed in a bad state after gym class... are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『うん……ちょっとペース配分間違えちゃった
　みたい。でも、すぐ治ったし』
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... I didn't pace myself too well, it seems. I'm fine
now, though."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... I didn't pace myself too well, it seems. I'm fine
now, though."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「無理すんなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't overexert yourself, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Don't overexert yourself, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『ふふ、心配してくれてありがとう』
dialogues.en: "Hehe, thanks for your concern."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, thanks for your concern."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そういや古文の時間にさ、覚えてるか？　田
　端の奴が……」
dialogues.en:
"And hey, do you remember literature class? That idiot
Tahata..."
dialogues.text:
"And hey, do you remember literature class? That idiot
Tahata..."

dialogues.jp:
こうして、昼間顔を合わせて話せなかったぶん
だけ、お喋りをし合う。
dialogues.en:
Since we couldn't talk face to face during the day, we
talked as much as we could now.
dialogues.text:
Since we couldn't talk face to face during the day, we
talked as much as we could now.

dialogues.jp: 学校のこと、友達のこと、楽しかったこと。
dialogues.en: About school, about friends, about fun stuff.
dialogues.text: About school, about friends, about fun stuff.

dialogues.jp: 今日は月が綺麗だねとか、
dialogues.en: About how the moon is pretty tonight,
dialogues.text: About how the moon is pretty tonight,

dialogues.jp: 雨が降っているねだとか。
dialogues.en: About how it's been raining so often lately.
dialogues.text: About how it's been raining so often lately.

dialogues.jp:
それは本当に他の人が聞いたらくだらないと思
うような事ばかりで、
dialogues.en:
This is just normal everyday chatter that isn't worth
thinking about to most people,
dialogues.text:
This is just normal everyday chatter that isn't worth
thinking about to most people,

dialogues.jp:
でも二人にとっては、世界を繋ぐ唯一の大切な
時間だった。
dialogues.en:
But for us, the only time where we could be together, it was
the most important thing we had.
dialogues.text:
But for us, the only time where we could be together, it was
the most important thing we had.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『……朝倉君』
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 会話の隙間に叶がふいに声を落とした。
dialogues.en:
During a pause in conversation, Kanae's voice suddenly
became softer.
dialogues.text:
During a pause in conversation, Kanae's voice suddenly
became softer.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『……私、また朝倉君と一緒にお弁当食べたい』
dialogues.en: "...I, I want to spend lunchtime eating with you again."
dialogues.text: "...I, I want to spend lunchtime eating with you again."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "...Kanae."
dialogues.text: "...Kanae."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『ふたり並んで登校したり、休み時間にお喋り
　したり……ふつうの女の子みたいに、ただ好
　きな人と一緒に……………………』
dialogues.en:
"I want to walk to school together with you, talk to you
during breaks... just like a normal girl, being with her
loved one..."
dialogues.text:
"I want to walk to school together with you, talk to you
during breaks... just like a normal girl, being with her
loved one..."

dialogues.jp: 声をつまらせる叶。
dialogues.en: Her voice had fallen to a whisper.
dialogues.text: Her voice had fallen to a whisper.

dialogues.en: "...Kanae, I..."
dialogues.text: "...Kanae, I..."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、叶の声はすぐに元気なトーンを取り戻
した。
dialogues.en:
But, her voice quickly returned back to a normal, energetic
tone.
dialogues.text:
But, her voice quickly returned back to a normal, energetic
tone.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんね……ワガママなこと言って』
dialogues.en: "Sorry... I was just being selfish there."
dialogues.text: "Sorry... I was just being selfish there."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『朝倉君のそばにいられるだけで、私はとって
　も幸せだよ』
dialogues.en: "As long as I can be by your side now, I'd be happy."
dialogues.text: "As long as I can be by your side now, I'd be happy."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Kanae..."
dialogues.text: "Kanae..."

dialogues.jp:
俺が口を開きかけたとき、急に電話の音声がく
ぐもった。叶が手で送話口を｛ふさ／塞｝いだらしい。こ
ほこほと咳き込む声がかすかに聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
Before I could open my mouth to speak any further, the sound
from the other line turned to muffled coughing.
dialogues.text:
Before I could open my mouth to speak any further, the sound
from the other line turned to muffled coughing.

dialogues.jp: 「叶！？　どうかしたのか」
dialogues.en: "Kanae!? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Kanae!? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 『なんでもない……ちょっとむせただけ』
dialogues.en: "Nothing... just accidentally dropped the phone."
dialogues.text: "Nothing... just accidentally dropped the phone."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
『じゃあ朝倉君、長くなっちゃったからそろそ
　ろ切るね。また明日学園で』
dialogues.en:
"Anyway Asakura-kun, I can't stay on the phone too long, so
I'd hang up now. See you at school tomorrow!"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway Asakura-kun, I can't stay on the phone too long, so
I'd hang up now. See you at school tomorrow!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ………………ああ。またな」
dialogues.en: "Ah........ ahh, see you."
dialogues.text: "Ah........ ahh, see you."

dialogues.jp:
電話を切った後も、俺の耳の奥には小さな咳が
残って離れなかった。
dialogues.en:
Even after the line was disconnected, the muffled sound of
coughing wouldn't leave my ears.
dialogues.text:
Even after the line was disconnected, the muffled sound of
coughing wouldn't leave my ears.

dialogues.jp:
何年もの間……叶は、男として生きるためにど
れだけの無理を重ねて来たんだろう？
dialogues.en:
How many years has it been since she started acting like a
guy... has all that stress finailly built up?
dialogues.text:
How many years has it been since she started acting like a
guy... has all that stress finailly built up?

dialogues.jp:
彼女の｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な身体には相当の負担が掛かってい
るに違いない。
dialogues.en:
There's no doubt that that delicate body is taking on
unneccessary strains, perhaps even more now.
dialogues.text:
There's no doubt that that delicate body is taking on
unneccessary strains, perhaps even more now.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ……」
dialogues.en: "Crap..."
dialogues.text: "Crap..."

dialogues.jp: 何か俺にできることはないのか！
dialogues.en: Isn't there anything I can do!?
dialogues.text: Isn't there anything I can do!?

dialogues.jp: ◆ただのクラスメイト◆
dialogues.en: ◆Just Another Classmate◆
dialogues.text: ◆Just Another Classmate◆

dialogues.jp:
あれから俺達は今までどおり、普通のクラスメ
イトとして振舞うようにした。今ではそういっ
た噂を聞く事もほとんどない。
dialogues.en:
Kanae and I started our lives as nothing more than normal
classmates. It worked, as the rumours quickly shifted away
from us.
dialogues.text:
Kanae and I started our lives as nothing more than normal
classmates. It worked, as the rumours quickly shifted away
from us.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、毎晩、真夜中の電話だけが俺達を繋いで
いた。
dialogues.en:
The only link we had, was the conversations we had at the
dead of the night.
dialogues.text:
The only link we had, was the conversations we had at the
dead of the night.

dialogues.jp:
あの｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な女の子が、男として生きる為には、
果たしてどんなに苦労がいることだろう。
dialogues.en:
That delicate body trying to live like a man's, must be
going through lots of pain...
dialogues.text:
That delicate body trying to live like a man's, must be
going through lots of pain...

dialogues.jp:
彼女の体には相当の負担が溜まっているはずだっ
た。
dialogues.en: Her body's had more than it's fair share of burden already.
dialogues.text: Her body's had more than it's fair share of burden already.

dialogues.jp: 叶を守りたい、俺は心からそう思ったのだった。
dialogues.en: From the bottom of my heart, I want to protect her.
dialogues.text: From the bottom of my heart, I want to protect her.
